system_thesis_interpretation: The proposal instantiates a deliberately reduced causal organism: public action/outcome episodes feed bounded recurrent Dream; Dream commits predictions before validation and then receives raw public A in a fresh pass; model-selected bytes pass through a representational Sleep boundary; the same reducer family later drives bounded memory reads and physical action. This is faithful to the owner's one-resolver/two-context idea at the level of a frozen prompted reference controller, and it cleanly prevents an exact verifier from owning the primary write decision. It is not the owner's full developmental organism: there is no per-life LoRA, lossy compression, repeated lifetime consolidation, wake-traversal-to-shortcut write, learned scheduler/critic/LOOP policy, memory-shaped evidence acquisition, or action-to-better-future-evidence feedback. Those arrows are explicitly excluded rather than falsely claimed. The scientific object is therefore a minimal pre-context causal survival assay for prospective connection, raw-evidence-conditioned revision, truth-blind text retention, and goal-conditioned action use in one synthetic cycle.
graph_delta_interpretation: The graph separates constructor/certifier, public source and A execution, recurrent Dream-1, recurrent Dream-2, branch selection, Sleep/indexing, reader/Think, actor, intervention builder, scorer, and audit sink. The primary route preserves ownership: the certifier makes only the world; Dream-1 authors candidates; raw A is ordinary evidence; Dream-2 authors the sole active SELF payload; Sleep copies or structurally validates without truth; Think requests local memory; the actor executes only emitted USE/LOCK; and truth joins only terminally. The OPAQUE_NOTE/OPERATOR_AST separation is architecturally important: opaque notes are the sole natural primary and have no registered denotation, while AST is a fresh-session operator-scaffolded diagnostic that cannot translate, rescue, or explain opaque output. The public-prefix-identical h fork is distinct from the antipodal z life-binding swap and correctly targets the A-to-revision edge. The graph does not include LoRA, multi-sleep life accumulation, adaptive replay, wake-generated agendas, or on-policy evidence selection, so it cannot instantiate or test those larger-organism arrows.
loop_delta_interpretation: The proposal defines a real shared recurrent kernel rather than merely reusing weights: RESOLVER_STEP, the canonical state tuple, parser, reducer, accounting order, workspace-node provenance, READ/NOTICE/CONNECT/REVISE/PASS mutations, and failure semantics are common to Dream and Think; mode changes eligible store/objective and terminal permissions. Dream-1 supplies bounded local traversal and prospective commitment; Dream-2 starts fresh, must explicitly read candidate/A handles, stages RETAIN or REVISE plus B predictions, and byte-binds the decision at COMMIT; Think uses the same state machinery for local queries and executed actions. This is a strong interface-level realization of one resolver in two invocation contexts, although it remains a prompted controller and the one-shot thinker is outside the reducer by design. The 32/16 operation caps, explicit malformed accounting, immutable commitments, single active Dream-2 payload, and no scientific retries prevent an external loop from silently searching or repairing. The h continuation fork makes correct branchwise B predictions and complementary target actions a causal revision endpoint, not mere output sensitivity. Sleep is intentionally not a cognitive loop here: it is a falsity-symmetric byte/structure compiler. The staged S1A-to-S1B loop is a resource/authority gate and must not be confused with an organism learning loop.
claim_delta_interpretation: The claim boundary is mostly disciplined. An all-pass Stage 0 can establish construct validity only. S1A/S1B can at most provide descriptive DEV evidence that a frozen prompted opaque-note path made prospective predictions, changed its selected memory as a function of raw A only when the shared-prefix fork passes, and used life-specific text for never-executed actions. AST success is a separate operator-scaffolded mechanism result; exact program, oracle schema, class-informed prompts, and perfect public filtering are ceilings. No result is headline-eligible, and LoRA/parametric transport, compression, context overflow, lifetime growth, population inference, on-policy self-improvement, learned control, naturalistic validity, SOTA superiority, or novelty priority remain forbidden. The proposal should distinguish temporally prior prediction performance from the causal effect of the later frozen corpus on action, and it should not imply that one-shot Think has been compared with opaque primary Think when the registered one-shot Think cells are structured only.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: The full matrix and expanded contract form a credible oracle firewall: hidden factors, target certificates, branch truth, and exact solutions remain in private construction and terminal scoring; Dream-1 cannot see A/B/targets; Dream-2 receives candidate/event catalogs and obtains contents only through charged reads, sees B requests but never outcomes, and receives no comparator rank or match bit; Sleep receives only selected payloads plus a public reference/token allowlist; Think sees targets only after corpus/index freeze and only through its assigned interface; the actor returns ordinary trays without correctness; and evaluation/B/scoring are terminal. Comparator mutation, target-manifest mutation, fresh process/KV/workspace/index namespaces, cross-life canaries, and append-only failure records are the right systems tests for covert ownership. The gate branch is explicitly a public-signal ceiling and cannot contaminate SELF. Two details require exact implementation clarification before execution: public event catalogs must not expose outcome-derived hashes, sizes, or other branch side channels before an explicit READ, and the offline scorer's generic wording about auditing corpus semantics/truth must be applied only to AST/structured lanes because opaque note truth is undefined.
acceptance_test_interpretation: T01 is the necessary total constructor/algebra/tree/chord gate and must retain rejected roots rather than cherry-pick. T02 correctly separates the 32 private (h,z) descriptions from the 16 target answers, tests S(h,z)=z xor h*1111, goal-twin non-goal equality, common-prefix h forking, and the independent q posterior. T03 makes executed D1/D4 causally meaningful through uniqueness, irrecoverable wrong prefixes, unexecuted decisive pairs, wrong-law/factor sensitivity, and shams. T04 is the key family-specificity control; its A-only/B-only/target-only acceptance factorization and exact conditional 16-way posterior are stronger than marginal matching. T05 enforces the T0-T7 chronology and target-descendant firewall needed to call predictions prospective. T06 is essential because schema comments do not implement semantics: prompt hashes, UTF-8 caps, strict cross-field parser fixtures, the shared reducer, lane identity, and the 2510/2279/247-byte AST fixture must all agree. T07 tests model ownership, literal bounded reads, no semantic retry, failure persistence, and a fair one-shot Dream comparison at matched public information/capacity/output entitlement while correctly reporting unmatched calls/input/FLOPs. T08 is the decisive no-hidden-verifier test: arbitrary private/comparator mutation must leave SELF Dream-2, corpus, index, prompts, and actions fixed. T09 correctly limits opaque conservation to unchanged bytes and provenance while reserving structural interpretation for AST; shape-matched false content and target-manifest mutation test Sleep's falsity symmetry. T10 verifies that SELF/gate/no-gate/hash/no-revision differences arise only after common traces and A bytes freeze. T11 appropriately gives opaque retrieval only surface overlap/hash ordering, gives AST only literal field postings, certifies structured 4/13-item and raw 25-call/15-event frontiers, and scans out solution packets; it does not prove an opaque semantic minimum. T12 validates that the endpoint is solvable without neural cognition and that the independent exact program abstains rather than importing private target truth. T13 protects baseline and lane fidelity, labels AST assistance, and makes unavailable native A-MEM root-wide NOT_RUN rather than accepting a substitute. T14 is required for nested targets/branches: clean processes, sentinel strings, immutable state hashes, and terminal evaluation prevent cross-target learning. T15 makes every sealed assignment terminal and failure-inclusive, eliminating survivorship, target replacement, and scientific retry. T16 is the mechanical feasibility gate for the 968 Dream, 7216 recurrent Think, 24 one-shot Think, and at-most-512 A-MEM envelope; it must resolve the presently unmeasured CPU/runtime and accounting ambiguities rather than relying on planning anchors. T17 correctly requires independent reviewer and separate author advocate approval of frozen bytes plus an authority-valid signed pre-GPU lock; neither verdict may enter the model. T18 is a conservative open-root survival gate for construct, exact/oracle ceilings, both h branch endpoints, opaque prospective packages, executed D4, goal conditioning, whole-corpus binding, sham behavior, and separately reported AST diagnostics. T19 is a descriptive untouched/specificity gate, not a chance or population test; it requires factor benefit over EMPTY/OBSERVED, both h endpoints, independent exact abstention, all nested q/z/goal rows, comparator invariance, non-rescuing AST reporting, and terminal HUMAN_REQUIRED. Collectively the tests can establish protocol fidelity and a minimal causal behavioral result; they cannot establish the omitted lifetime, compression, LoRA, learned-loop, or population claims.
assumptions: The exact canonical proposal bytes are the file whose SHA-256 is b6464058e7a2b522fb8b7f13835cd8f4c961f8b946f6019d562dbf9bca22e37e, and all declared context-file hashes were independently recomputed and matched.

A model call is deterministic enough for the continuation instrument because Dream-1 is executed once and its immutable artifact is cloned; the two Dream-2 calls need not be byte-identical, only isolated and seeded by the same predeclared role rule.
The public tray renderer and extracted permutation are common supplied preprocessing, so no claim is made about learning perception or local operator extraction.

The structured runtime validator and reducer, not JSON Schema annotations alone, will enforce phase/op cardinality, type checking, UTF-8 byte limits, exact prediction-ID sets, uniqueness, ancestry, and terminal byte binding.
All Y contrasts in S1A/S1B are computed over a predeclared failure-inclusive set of nested target/goal/side rows within each orbit root; no nested row is treated as an independent replicate.

The exact program is a non-neural ceiling whose actions may be executed without attributing its computation to the recurrent Think model, even if the resource table conservatively allocates a recurrent-call upper bound to its condition slot.
A-MEM is optional exactly as stated: absence of a licensed already-vendored faithful implementation yields a root-wide NOT_RUN and removes any compilation-versus-A-MEM conclusion.
No current proposal, interpretation, advisory agreement, or broad owner directive is exact human ratification or implementation/GPU authority.

ambiguities.question: Exactly which fields are present in the Dream-1 and Dream-2 public event catalogs before a READ, especially whether A outcome hashes, byte counts, timing, or other outcome-derived metadata are visible?
ambiguities.impact: If outcome-derived catalog metadata differs across h/q branches, Dream-2 could follow a side channel without reading raw A, weakening the claim that the registered evidence path caused revision. T05, T07, T08, and T14 should require catalogs to expose only predeclared IDs/action/time/shape fields and force outcome contents plus their hashes/sizes behind the charged READ receipt.

ambiguities.question: What exact failure-inclusive aggregation and pairing defines 'directionally above,' 'redirects,' and the S1B SELF-minus-control directions across h/q, z/antipode, targets, and goal twins?
ambiguities.impact: The gates are deterministic but their inequalities are not fully executable until numerator, denominator, weighting, tie handling, and branch matching are frozen. Without that definition, a gate receipt could vary while using the same terminal rows.

ambiguities.question: How are the eight q-by-z-by-goal SELF rows paired with the four 'ordinary-q' EMPTY/OBSERVED rows when the two q branches can have independently coupled B/target blocks?
ambiguities.impact: Reusing controls across q may be valid under the certified symmetry, but that symmetry and exact pairing must be stated. Otherwise the descriptive specificity concern can mix branch treatment with target-instance differences.

ambiguities.question: Does T16 require the literal per-root worst case to fit the aggregate CPU budget, or only measured/synthetic execution of the complete roster under both a 30-minute per-root cutoff and a 24-CPU-hour global stop?
ambiguities.impact: The independent maxima 128 roots times 30 minutes equal 64 CPU-hours, while the aggregate cap is 24 CPU-hours. This is operationally coherent as competing stop limits but not as a claim that every per-root maximum simultaneously fits; the acceptance receipt must state the intended interpretation.

ambiguities.question: Why does the literal 7216 recurrent-Think table allocate an 82/164-call recurrent condition slot to EXACT_PROGRAM when that arm is defined as a non-LLM public program/planner?
ambiguities.impact: This is conservative for the 9000-call cap but obscures the exact assignment ledger and the meaning of T16's sealed call counts. The manifest should distinguish reserved upper-bound slots from actual model invocations.

ambiguities.question: Does the visibility matrix phrase that the offline scorer audits 'semantics, truth' apply only to OPERATOR_AST and structured ceilings, or also to OPAQUE_NOTE_SELF?
ambiguities.impact: Applying semantic truth analysis to opaque notes would contradict the primary contract and introduce the very interpreter the two-lane design excludes. The terminal scorer may audit opaque bytes, provenance, predictions, actions, and interventions only.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The maximum primary-lane sentence should not say that the resulting life-specific text 'causally improved exact prospective predictions and executed actions.'
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Dream-1 A and Dream-2 B predictions are committed before Sleep produces the target-time corpus; corpus interventions therefore cannot cause those predictions. The continuation fork can show that raw A caused branch-correct B prediction and selected-memory differences, while whole-corpus interventions can show that the selected text caused later action differences. Combining both under one causal verb misstates the graph.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Replace the clause with: 'the resolver made exact prospective predictions, raw A caused branch-appropriate revision when the continuation conjunction passed, and the resulting life-specific text causally changed executed actions on never-executed compounds.' Keep each clause conditional on its corresponding gate.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The proposal cannot claim that recurrent target-time resolution differed from matched one-shot resolution for the primary opaque organism under the registered matrix.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: ONE_SHOT_THINK is run only on open-factor ORACLE and OPERATOR_AST and independent OPERATOR_AST cells, not on OPAQUE_NOTE_SELF. Those structured packets test whether iterative planning is needed when an exact/scaffolded representation is available, but they do not remove the recurrent Think loop from the opaque causal path. Consequently a primary opaque success establishes bounded goal-conditioned use, not an advantage or necessity of recurrent Think.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Either add a predeclared OPAQUE_NOTE_SELF one-shot Think cell with the exact corpus bytes, item/order exposure, action budget, output entitlement, continuation/goal pairing, and revised resource roster, or narrow graph/claim/test language so the one-shot Think comparison is explicitly structured-only and iterative-Think necessity for opaque SELF remains untested.
